messages:
sam (AE): FYI — Acme Robotics just pushed back on standard terms. They want NET45 + a 25% volume discount on inference usage for a 3yr commit. quote-bot generated Q-2026-358. Need finance + legal approval to proceed.
marie (FinOps): Can you paste the expected monthly usage / ARR? 25% is pretty material.
sam (AE): Ballpark: starting 150k tokens/day ramping to ~1.2M tokens/day by Q4. ARR estimate ~$1.1M if we use standard pricing. With 25% off + net45 that changes cashflow.
jonas (RevOps): Net45 + 25% effectively reduces NPV. We usually cap deep discounts for multiyear at commit levels >= $2M ARR or with prepay. Any willingness to prepay?
sam (AE): They said they can't prepay due to procurement cycles — vendor policy. That's why they're asking net45.
marie (FinOps): Suggested counter: tiered volume discount with slim upfront: 10% year1, 18% year2, 25% year3 contingent on usage bands and SOW. Also require a revenue protection clause (min monthly commitment).
kevin (Legal): Need to see the proposed SOW and any confidentiality/NDA asks. Net45 is okay if credit terms pass our risk review; for >$500k ARR we want credit insurance or parent company guarantee.
elaine (SalesEng): Technical note: they want private deployment in eu-west-1 for data residency, plus optional edge cache nodes. That adds infra op cost — we should factor that into discount calculus.
quote-bot: Quote Q-2026-358 v1: base price $0.0006/token, volume tiers: 0-500k/day = 0.0006, 500k-1.5M/day = 0.00048 (20%), 1.5M+ = 0.00036 (40%). Includes optional private infra surcharge +15%.
marie (FinOps): That quote has overlapping discounts — we usually normalize to a single effective discount. Proposed normalized offer: effective 12% year1, 20% year2, 25% year3 with a 12-month minimum monthly commitment equal to $45k/mo. Private infra surcharge could be used instead of an additional discount.
jonas (RevOps): If we structure as commit + step-up discounts, we can approve on finance side. Also recommend adding automatic price rollback if usage falls below commit for >60 days.
kevin (Legal): I'll draft the credit terms and the SLA addendum for private infra. Also need to limit indemnities for third-party infra.
sam (AE): Thanks — can we get mark from finance here? marie, jonas — are you comfortable signing off subject to: (1) 12/20/25% step discounts, (2) 12-mo min commit $45k/mo, (3) net45 with parent guarantee or credit insurance, (4) private infra surcharge in lieu of greater discount?
marie (FinOps): I'm +1 provisionally. Want one more check: if they ramp slower, we need a clause to preserve margin (price floor). Otherwise ok from budgeting POV. :thumbsup:
jonas (RevOps): +1. I'll add the rollback clause and set the approval as contingent on the signed SOW and credit docs. :white_check_mark:
kevin (Legal): I'll aim to circulate a redline by EOD tomorrow. Need to confirm whether the parent guarantee is acceptable.
sam (AE): Awesome — I'll update the customer and ask procurement to fast-track parent guarantee conversation. Will post updated SOW and PO when available. :eyes:
marie (FinOps): One more item — accounting treatment: with net45 and multiyear commit we should recognize revenue monthly but reserve right to defer certain discounts until end of each year based on actual usage. I'll coordinate with accounting.
quote-bot: Attached files: Q-2026-358.pdf, usage-projection.xlsx
elaine (SalesEng): FYI the private infra lead time is ~6 weeks after PO. Ensure procurement knows the lead time so launch expectations are realistic.
sam (AE): Summary: provisional internal approval for step discounts (12/20/25%), net45 allowed with guarantee/insurance, 12mo min commit $45k/mo, private infra surcharge applies, legal to produce redline. Leave open until SOW + credit docs received.
marie (FinOps): Sounds good. Please tag me when SOW is uploaded.
jonas (RevOps): I'll update deal record and mark approval notes. :memo:
kevin (Legal): Added to my queue.
sam (AE): Thanks team. Closing thread for now — will reopen if procurement pushes back. :handshake:
